_comment: Single record of every model pin in the AMMO session template.
It records current reality; it does not select models at runtime.
tests/unit/test_model_roster.py asserts each pin site still agrees, so a
model bump that misses a site fails loudly instead of drifting.
Update this file in the SAME edit as the pin site.

aliases._comment: Claude Code alias -> model id. settings.local.json env holds these.

claude._comment: Pins in ai_cli_session/.claude. Agent values are an alias or an explicit id. Every opus agent follows the opus alias; see docs/AMMO_DEEP_DIVE.md 'Which model runs which agent' for the rationale.

inline_hook_models._comment: Agent-type hooks inside agent frontmatter carry their own pin.

codex._comment: The generated CODEX_HOME config wins at runtime; the project copy is the template. Both must state the same model.
